method.value: Fit 2D Gaussians with shape fixed to synthesized beam to each channel with >6 sigma emission; manual inspection to discard artifacts

evidence.quote: we fit each channel of the cube that had significant emission ($> 6\sigma$, measured independently for each channel) with an appropriate number of two-dimensional Gaussian sources.

analysis_steps.goal: Derive line-of-sight magnetic field from OH Zeeman pairs

method.value: Pair RCP/LCP spots within 1/3 of beam minor axis, fit Gaussians, B = (Vc(RCP)-Vc(LCP))/Z

evidence.quote: $B_{los}=$($V_{center}(RCP) - V_{center}(LCP)$)$/Z$ where $Z = 0.056$ km s$^{-1}$mG$^{-1}$ for the 6.035 GHz transition and $0.079$ km s$^{-1}$mG$^{-1}$ for the 6.030 GHz transition
Then the RCP and LCP profiles for each Zeeman pair were independently fitted using Gaussian profiles.

validation.value: compared with Caswell11 LBA Zeeman pairs; agreement within 10%

evidence.quote: differences in $B_{los}$ are less than $10\%$

findings_qualitative.value: Strongest MM1 masers lie in dust cavities, absent toward MM1A, B, D
